notes.title: World Zone Revamp and World League Related Changes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/438d70a433e0be610e8c352da228ba65e667b621.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals.

Following the July 30, UTC (July 29, PDT) update, the World Zone Revamp and new World League will begin. We would like to inform you about various changes.

Please review the detailed information below.

[h3][b]■ World Zone Revamp and World League Related Changes[/b][/h3]

[b]•  APEX Arena [/b]
- From July 28, 00:55 UTC (July 27, 17:55 PDT)
- Until August 4, 00:55 UTC (August 3, 17:55 PDT)
- APEX Arena will be suspended during this period.

[b]•  [Alliance] World Mission [/b]
- From July 29, 00:00 UTC (July 28, 17:00 PDT) 
- Until July 30, 01:00 UTC (July 29, 18:00 PDT)]
- The end time for the [Alliance] World Mission "Victory Points (Admiral Battles & Base Defense Victories)” starting at July 29, 01:00 UTC (July 28, 18:00 PDT) will be extended by 1 hour.
[b]※ This schedule adjustment will only be applied once to missions ending at July 30, 00:00 UTC (July 29, 17:00 PDT).[/b]

[b]•  [Admiral] World Mission [/b]
- From July 29, 18:00 UTC (July 29, 11:00 PDT) 
- Until July 30, 01:00 UTC (July 29, 18:00 PDT)
- The end time for the [Admiral] World Mission "Successfully Attack Armada Bases" starting at July 29, 18:00 UTC (July 29, 11:00 PDT) will be extended by 1 hour.
[b]※ This schedule adjustment will only be applied once to missions ending at July 30, 00:00 UTC (July 29, 17:00 PDT).[/b]

[b]•  Language-Specific Chat Reset [/b]
- From July 30, after maintenance
- Language-specific chat content will be reset due to the World Zone Revamp.

[b]•  Armada Time Attack Reset [/b]
- From July 30, after maintenance
- Armada Time Attack rankings and best records will be reset due to the World Zone Revamp.

[b]•  World War [/b]
- From July 30, after maintenance
- World War tournament winner server banners will be removed and World War records will be reset.

[b]•  New Admiral Accumulated Gametime Event [/b]
- From July 30, after maintenance
- The "New Gametime Event" that was running on some servers will end.

[b]•  World Zone Revamp [/b]
- From July 30, after maintenance
- As the Server Transfer Event ends, Worlds will be assigned based on the "Highest Combat Power" of the final Top 50 users per server according to current server transfer criteria.
[b]※ "Highest Combat Power" refers to the Combat Power displayed in Combat Power Achievement Reward.[/b]
- World Zones will be revamped into Pioneer, Gold, Platinum, Master, and Grandmaster, and Alliance Symbol appearances will change according to World tier.
- Since World Zone 2 and World Zone 3 are relatively recently created servers, they will receive server Combat Power advantages: World 2 will be assigned based on 90% of server Combat Power, and World 3 will be assigned based on 80% of server Combat Power.
[b]※ All remaining lower servers will be assigned to Pioneer World.[/b]
- We are providing the final World assignments based on the current Top 50 Combat Power of each server below:
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/5da017fd55822aeea5d940f7c32ac1b992ef3733.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/33a364f4da4aa1fcdd8701b204cbbceb59e35b17.png[/img]

[b]※ New World League tournament rules will be announced through separate notices in the future.[/b]

We hope you’re looking forward to the upcoming World Zone Revamp and World League, and we’ll continue doing our best to provide you with even better service.
Thank you.

notes.title: July Developer Note - Hero Deployment & Alliance Treasure
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/f77a168644d7ac20e0c57673dc67b8f4922143b2.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals.

I am Ja-ram Jeon, the Lead Producer of Gunship Battle Total Warfare.

In addition to details provided regarding the upcoming changes to the World League, we'd like to introduce some other great updates coming this month through this Developer Note.

Please check the details below.


[h2][b][Heroes – Enter the Battlefield][/b][/h2]
Heroes assigned to the Command Post at the Phase Gate can now be deployed onto the battlefield alongside your Ships and Jets.

An [b]"Assign Hero" [/b]tab will be added to the CSG Reserves, allowing you to utilize your Heroes more effectively.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/4936132eeface32fb34d0294d10893afe0a6f62d.png[/img]
[b]※ Heroes can also be assigned through CSG Reserves Presets.[/b]
[b]※ Heroes assigned in the Command Post can also be deployed through CSG Reserves.[/b]

When Heroes are assigned to the Fleet, Hero buffs will be applied to the Units in combat, and these effects will increase further as Hero levels rise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/8202395d422e2a0b102cc283714aea20572d5f2f.png[/img]

Additionally, after each battle, you can check detailed information about Hero contributions in the battle report. We hope you will actively utilize Heroes to assist in your strategic planning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/c1a58ef24ae70b4229c66a33622d8ad3a69f70ec.png[/img]
  

[h2][b][Powerful Training! Hero Limit Break System][/b][/h2]
The[b] "Hero Limit Break"[/b] system will be added, empowering Legendary Heroes to grow even more powerful.

Hero Limit Break consumes Hero Fragments and is only available for Legendary Heroes that have reached Level 60.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/5a666a9eb01f4b57a72d97caf6283515976b38df.png[/img]
[b]※ When Limit Break is performed, the Hero level will reset to 1, but all effects unlocked before the Limit Break will be maintained.[/b]
[b]※ When Hero Limit Break is performed, Limit Break buffs will be applied based on the Limit Break stage.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/c9f67bf65da6d2c595fece67c3046903ebd852f9.png[/img]

Additionally, after a successful Limit Break is attained, Hero XP can only be accumulated and leveled up through the [b]"Limit Break Training"[/b] system. A [b]"Skill Reset"[/b] system will be added to the Hero Field, allowing 70% of Hero Fragments used for Skill upgrade to be refunded.
[b]※ After Hero Limit Break is added in-game, a portion of Legendary Hero fragments that have been used in the Coin Shop will be refunded.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/6213da37f0f85ddff85a507246496466ace05617.png[/img]

The Hero Limit Break system will awaken Heroes' potential and allow further growth to help Admirals build a stronger force.  


[h2][b][Alliance Treasure][/b][/h2]
A new Alliance feature called "Alliance Treasure" will be added after the July update.

[b]"Alliance Loot Boxes"[/b] can be obtained based on Alliance rallies, and [b]"Alliance Member Gift Boxes"[/b] can be obtained when purchasing products using Ruby or purchasing Epic Special products. Each time you claim these rewards, you can obtain [b]"Alliance Treasure Box Keys"[/b].
[b]※ "Alliance Loot Boxes" cannot be obtained during solo rallies.[/b]
[b]※ "Alliance Loot Boxes" have daily acquisition limits and reset the next day.[/b]
[b]※ Alliance Bonus that is sent to Alliance members upon making Epic Special purchases, will be renewed and integrated into Alliance Treasure.[/b]

For rallies against "Armada Base," "Royal Armada Base," "Armada Strike Group," "Pirate Annihilation," and " Sub Force," Alliance Loot Boxes will be distributed to all Alliance members [b]"once per rally,"[/b] credited to the Admiral who started the rally.
[b]※ Number of participants in the rally does not affect the rewards.[/b]

Additionally, each Alliance has an [b]"Alliance Treasure Box."[/b]
Alliance Treasure Box Keys obtained by Alliance members when receiving box rewards will automatically accumulate in the gauge, allowing the level of that box to grow.

When the Alliance Treasure Box reaches maximum level, rewards respective to the level attained will be distributed.
[b]※ Alliance Treasure Boxes will disappear after a certain period, so please claim them in advance.[/b]
[b]※ When multiple Alliance Treasure Boxes are accumulated, rewards can be acquired in the order accumulated.[/b]

The “Alliance Treasure” will make Alliance growth and gameplay richer by strengthening the bond and teamwork between Alliance members.

We will continue to do our best to provide a more enjoyable combat experience that can be enjoyed by you and your Alliance.
Thank you.

[b]※ Images used in this notice are examples and test images that may change upon update.[/b]

notes.title: Introducing the New Legendary Jet [Su-47 White Wing]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/438d70a433e0be610e8c352da228ba65e667b621.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals.

We're excited to unveil the Su-47 White Wing, an Anti-Ship Jet equipped with new skills!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/317dbaa9553bf69f02384e288c21b31393bcca29.png[/img]

Utilizing the data obtained from the experimental Su-47 Obj.101, its predecessor’s advantages of forward-swept wings for exceptional maneuverability and acceleration have been maximized for the newest iteration, the 'White Wing'.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/09e69988e133b5acfb045b4ffd66f8eabfbd0f2b.png[/img]

Armada soldiers who witnessed its rapid fleet assault attacks reportedly trembled in fear, saying “The white reaper has risen.”
We hope that the newly deployed White Wing will become a symbol of victory in your strategic operations.

[h3][b]Stats[/b][/h3]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/d607dab2ceaa610d524df1eef21cb87d5c35c698.png[/img]
[b]※ Stats of Su-47 White Wing at Lv.30 with no Buffs activated.[/b]

[h3][b]Skills[/b][/h3]
• Skill I [Evasion, Armor, and Movement Speed Enhancement] (Unlocks at Jet Level 5)
•	Increases Evasion, Armor, and Movement Speed by 7.5%-150% (Percentage varies depending on the Skill Level)

• Skill II [Anti-Ship ATK Enhancement] (Unlocks at Jet Level 10)
•	Increases Anti-Ship ATK by 7.5%-150% (Percentage varies depending on the Skill Level)

• Skill III [Ship Immobilization Chance Enhancement] (Unlocks at Jet Level 15)
•	In battle, Airstrike has a 1.5%-30% chance to inflict Immobilization on the enemy Ships for 1 turn. The highest value among squadrons is preserved and added together. (Other squadrons: Divided by 2, 3, 4, ... respectively in descending order, then added together)

• Skill IV [ATK Enhancement] (Unlocks at Jet Level 20)
•	Increases ATK by 10%-105% (Percentage varies depending on the Skill Level)

[h3][b]How to Obtain[/b][/h3]
- Shop
- Armada Strike Group

notes.title: July Developer Note - World League & World Zone Realignment
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/f77a168644d7ac20e0c57673dc67b8f4922143b2.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals.

I am Ja-ram Jeon, the Lead Producer of Gunship Battle: Total Warfare.

Last June, we shared the news of the upcoming World Zone realignment and the implementation of the brand-new World League.  

In this month’s update, the World League system will be introduced. Before the update, we'd like to share a more in-depth explanation of the upcoming changes.

Please check the details below.


[h2][b][World League – World Zone Realignment] [/b][/h2]
We would like to begin by thanking all our Admirals who provided some fantastic feedback through the survey on World Revamp. Your valuable opinions helped our team set some benchmarks when planning and developing the World League system. 

The World League system will divide Servers into Worlds based on the total Combat Power of the Top 50 Admirals with the highest CP on the Server.
[b]※ 'Highest Combat Power' refers to the Combat Power displayed in Combat Power Achievement rewards.[/b]

The World League consists of a total of five Worlds: Pioneer, Gold, Platinum, Master, and Grand Master, and Alliance Symbol be changed to indicate which World the respective Alliance belongs in. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/d5024da6b757b9ae88a22768c5446cc67ba108a9.png[/img] 

Additionally, with the World League realignment, in-game features such as APEX Arena, World Boss, World Mission, World Ranking, Armada Time Attack, Language-Specific World Chat, World War, Server Invasion, and Server Transfer will be reorganized by World, League, and Division.
[b]※ Information respective in some features may be reset due to the World League realignment.[/b]

Grand Master, Master, Platinum, and Gold Worlds consist of 24 Servers each, and all remaining Servers will be placed in Pioneer World, including Servers that open after the World Zone realignment takes place.

Each World is divided into two Leagues: Pacific League and Atlantic League, and within each League are two Divisions: Red Division and Blue Division, similar to the existing WWL format.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/c9b43f6e2271fb71c46ae1d096abba2f10367e0c.png[/img]

Please note that Pioneer World will not be divided into Leagues or Divisions, nor will any Worlds during Tournament pre-season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/d302ba7a49a749bd03dc3736f82c5cf6d61dc1cd.png[/img]
 

[h2][b][Initial Server Assignment][/b][/h2]
Server Transfer will take place from July 16, after maintenance, until July 23, before maintenance, prior to the World League update.

Servers will be assigned into Worlds, Leagues, and Divisions based on the total Combat Power of the Top 50 Admirals with the highest CP after Server Transfer ends. 

Since Servers in World Zone 2 and World Zone 3 have been created relatively recently compared to those in World Zone 1, they will receive Server Combat Power advantages during the initial World League assignment process.

The remaining Servers with lower CP will be assigned to Pioneer World.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/76a4c09b68ce893a1b7d9cd9397292c2b4a78dad.png[/img]
[b]※ This is the expected Server placement in each World League based on Server Combat Power before Server Transfer. [/b]
[b]※ World Zone 2: Assigned based on 90% of Server’s Combat Power. [/b]
[b]World Zone 3: Assigned based on 80% of Server’s Combat Power.[/b]


[h2][b][World League Tournament][/b][/h2]
The next tournament will add new rules in line with the World League update.

The World League Tournament will follow the existing WWL format, with Servers being divided into Red and Blue Divisions. Each server will compete once against every other Server within its assigned Division, and league rankings will be determined based on the results of final ranking matches. 

Once each Server’s ranking within the League is finalized, the strongest Server in the World will be decided through the final World Series ranking match.

Based on final rankings through ranking matches, 1st-3rd place Servers in each World will be promoted to higher Worlds, while 22nd-24th place Servers will be relegated to lower Worlds.
[b]※ Servers in Grandmaster World will not be promoted.[/b]
[b]※ Servers in Gold World will not be relegated.[/b]
[b]※ Pioneer World will not conduct tournaments, and some top Servers may be promoted to Gold World after the World League season ends.[/b]

If there are insufficient Servers in higher Worlds due to Server merge, Servers next in ranking may be eligible for promotion.
[b]※ World League Tournament schedules will be announced through future notices.[/b]


[h2][b][Server List UI Reorganization][/b][/h2]
Along with the World League reorganization, the Server list UI will be reorganized to allow Admirals to view the Server lists of other Worlds Leagues.

In the reorganized Server list UI, Division of each Server in the World will be indicated by their respective color (Red or Blue).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/9e25b8e3a4a531b8326ee0ba57cd348cae6e4ed4.png[/img]

Additionally, spectator features including spectator-only chat and 1:1 chat features will be added. Spectating other Servers will only be available for adjacent Worlds (one tier above or below).
[b]※ Spectating is limited to a maximum of 10 spectators, 30 minutes spectating time, and 24 hours spectating cooldown.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/00d45ca8ef8e9c3f43ecbbed96ae73fdca034553.png[/img]
 

[h2][b][Other Changes][/b][/h2]
[b]◆ Server Transfer Post-Update[/b]
Currently, Server Transfers are limited to World Zones, except for transfers from World Zone 2 to World Zone 1.

After the World League update, Server Transfers will be extended to the adjacent World Leagues (one tier above or below).
[b]※ Server Transfers are only possible to one adjacent World based on the World prior to the server transfer event.[/b]

[b]◆ Server Invasion[/b]
The same system will be applied to Server Invasion. Currently limited to Servers in the same World Zone, Admirals will now be able to invade Servers in the adjacent World Leagues. (One tier above or below).

Some features may be restricted when invading other Worlds, and World Mission (Alliance Victory Points) and World Ranking points will not accumulate.
[b]※ When jumping to Servers in a lower-tier World during Server Invasion, anonymization will not be applied and Admiral information will be exposed.[/b]

[b]◆ Rewards[/b]
Rewards for certain features will be increased for higher-tier Worlds.

In the initial update, rewards for the following four in-game features will be increased: World Mission, Armada Strike Group, APEX Arena, and World War. Additional increases are planned for future updates.

Features with increased rewards based on World Leagues can be checked in the World selection UI.
 

This concludes our introduction of the World League and World Zone Realignment planned for the July update.

We hope that the new World League will provide you with a more enjoyable and competitive gameplay experience.

Thank you.

[b]※ Images used in this notice are examples and test images that may change upon update.[/b]

notes.title: June Developer Note – The Arrival of a New Aircraft Carrier & Assault
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/f77a168644d7ac20e0c57673dc67b8f4922143b2.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals.
I am Ja-ram Jeon, the Lead Producer of Gunship Battle Total Warfare.

In this Developer Note, we’d like to introduce the latest Aircraft Carrier, John F. Kennedy, along with other notable upcoming updates.

This month’s update is also available in a special form; an AI Patchcast —for those of you who prefer to listen than to read, be sure to check it out for further insight on this update! 

[previewyoutube=8s8NOmW_ZHE;full][/previewyoutube][b]※ Please keep in mind that this is an AI-generated patchcast and pronunciation may be unclear at times.
[/b]

[h2][b][Hidden Armada Base Detected! Launch the Assault Operation!][/b][/h2]
A new PvE feature, [b]“Assault Operation”[/b], is coming. In this new content, you’ll take on the challenge of infiltrating hidden Armada Bases scattered across the sea.

Similar to APEX Arena, this new feature will require the usage of Ships and Heroes for combat. 

Upon entering combat, you’ll be assigned a preset fleet composed of Tier 14, Level 100, Ships, so what will matter most is the growth and strength of your Heroes. 

The progress of different core features—Research, Hero Skills, Collection, Jet Tactics, and Carrier Module Upgrades—will be reflected in the Assault Operation, further enhancing your power with additional bonuses.

Assault Operation will be available for Admirals with HQ Lv. 18 and above.

Different terrains are available, and each will open on specific days only from Monday to Saturday. On Sunday, all terrains will be open and players will be able to choose which terrain to participate in.

Each themed terrain consists of 50 Stages, and all stages can be played and completed again.
Rewards are granted for:
- First clear
- Extermination
- Cumulative stage clear progress

Progress resets every Monday at 00:00 UTC, allowing you to earn Extermination Rewards again.

In addition, a special currency obtained from the Assault Operation can be exchanged in the feature-exclusive Shop for core items.

Shop purchase limits reset every Monday.

We hope this new PvE feature provides you with an exciting new way to apply the power you’ve built throughout your journey!


[h2][b][New Aircraft Carrier: John F. Kennedy][/b][/h2]
For the first time in 3 years since the release of Gerald R. Ford on December 8, 2021, a new Aircraft Carrier,[b] “John F. Kennedy”[/b] is now joining the battlefield!

The John F. Kennedy can be produced after reaching Gerald R. Ford Lv. 3 and it has the ability to load “Special Missiles”, unlike other Aircraft Carriers.

Upon obtaining the John F. Kennedy, Special Missiles can be produced in the Missile Factory and can increase the chances of dealing additional damage to enemy Carriers during attacks.

If attack is successful, Special Missiles will significantly reduce the enemy Carrier’s Durability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/064c8d804e80dcf120e9c837abe7bac0bf79d0b3.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/74e9ce30baf470cc10f5e88c68047103007f4393.gif[/img]
[b]※ Footage shown is from test builds and is subject to change upon official release.[/b]

But wait, that is not all that the John F. Kennedy has to offer!
Powerful, special abilities never seen before are unlocked for each level of the John F. Kennedy.

[h3][b]Unique Abilities of John F. Kennedy[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/cc344486e4a48e5539bffa0a588649960b08dfe6.png[/img]
[b]> Last Stand[/b]
: When the Carrier’s Durability reaches 0, it temporarily recovers Durability, removes debuffs, gains immunity to Malfunctions, and reduces incoming Durability damage.
[b]※ Durability will not be recovered unless ACC is repaired in Base. [/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/d6564dc4dd50dd08e41358c261445d9925a86ca5.png[/img]
[b]> Guided Bombing[/b]
: During naval battles, there is a chance that an E-2 Hawkeye Warning will appear to detect enemies and trigger a bombing attack.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/563f5931fc7924b4728fb4a980d9fb22923d992e.png[/img]
[b]> Fleet Management[/b]
: Adds one additional Fleet management slot, allowing up to 8 Fleets to be deployed.
[b]※ Only active when the John F. Kennedy is deployed as the Command Carrier.[/b]

Additionally, the John F. Kennedy inherits the special abilities of Gerald R. Ford:
- One-Man Rally
- Jet Deployment Count Increase

We hope this new Aircraft Carrier with its overwhelming power and support capabilities becomes a key force in your naval dominance.

[h2][b][Improved Benefits for PC & Standalone APK Versions][/b][/h2]
Benefits for the PC and APK versions are being improved!
[b]※ APK refers to the Android APK downloadable from the Joy Store.[/b]

[url=https://gw.joycity.com/pcplay/en][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/d59ebcfa5e2cf676caaa573359840e15d4c320b3.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.joycitymobile.com/web/detail?id=com.joycity.gw&lng=en-US][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/9a7a638682699a135b8ae65872bbd33c37348e22.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://gw.joycity.com/pcplay/en][b][Download PC Version][/b][/url]
[url=https://www.joycitymobile.com/web/detail?id=com.joycity.gw&lng=en-US][b][Download APK][/b][/url]

To provide a smoother gameplay experience, an exclusive buff will be granted instantly upon accessing the game via the PC or APK version.

These buffs are displayed as a separate category in the [b]"Active Buffs"[/b] popup and as buff effects being applied in [b]“Admiral Skills.”[/b]

As part of this update, existing login mail rewards for PC & APK access will be removed and a new daily mission exclusive to PC & APK versions will be added.

These Daily Missions will only be available on the PC & APK versions, so be sure to check them out for additional rewards!
[b]※ Due to Steam's operational policies, this update will not be applied to the Steam version.
*Added on June 25, 2025, 04:10 UTC (June 24, 2025, 21:10 PDT)[/b]

That wraps up our preview of the updates planned for June.

From the new PvE content Assault Operation to the powerful new Aircraft Carrier, John F. Kennedy, and enhanced PC & APK version benefits, we hope these changes will bring exciting changes to your strategy and gameplay.

We will continue doing our best to provide an even more enjoyable experience for all Admirals.

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Note - Improving Server Stability
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/f77a168644d7ac20e0c57673dc67b8f4922143b2.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals!

This is Ja-ram Jeon, Lead Producer of Gunship Battle Total Warfare.

Due to the recent unexpected game server instability issues, emergency maintenance was performed, and the root errors that caused the issues were identified and resolved. 

However, the maintenance lasted longer than we had anticipated, directly affecting the gameplay experience of our Admirals. Regardless of the cause, I feel as if I must apologize for the trouble this situation has caused all of you. Our inability to provide seamless service for our GBTW players, especially during this time, was jarring.

We want to be as transparent as possible. 

In this Developer Note, we will explain the root cause(s) of the server issues and what actions we took to resolve them. And more, I’ll outline our future improvement plans to prevent such problems from recurring.

[h3][b][Service Stability Issues and Response][/b][/h3]
In a previous Developer Note released in November 2024, we shared our plans to address issues including server delay and unexpected crashes on iOS devices.

Thanks to the reports and feedback shared by many Admirals, we thoroughly reviewed major game features to detect irregularities, and we’ve been implementing improvements every month.

Our goal has been to identify the root cause of these issues and to optimize the game client and server for a better gameplay environment. Below is a summary of our findings so far:

[b]1. iOS Forced Closure Issue Fixed[/b]
Some iOS users reported random crashes during gameplay, and we have applied a fix to prevent recurrence. Many cases have already been resolved, and we will continue to monitor and manage the issue closely.

[b]2. Improved Gameplay Performance[/b]
To reduce in-game lag and glitches, we have optimized the way the game loads data and improved memory usage. These changes help keep the game running more smoothly, even during extended playtime.

[b]3. Server Optimization[/b]
At times of high traffic, the servers would experience delays or temporarily freeze. To resolve this, we enhanced the servers’ ability to handle large amounts of data simultaneously and simplified the data exchange between client and server. A total of 55 optimization tasks have been implemented so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/9285df634d4655ad222ecbd9ee3aefa06e548817.png[/img]

These updates were steadily rolled out in monthly updates:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/20ed9a4e3a7532f020406ed46cffb67ca2ad1c8c.png[/img]

We’re aware that further improvements are still needed, especially during large-scale unit deployments where lag can occur, and are actively working on additional optimization. 

[h3][b][Our Commitment and Next Steps][/b][/h3]
While our team is always looking to improve your gameplay experience, we recognize that we may have overlooked some key areas in an attempt to fix the issues. 

We are currently working around the clock to resolve all ongoing issues and promise to double down on our efforts to maintain stable service going forward.

Moving forward, we are committed to the following:

1.	Conducting more rigorous testing before updates to detect and address potential issues early.

2.	Strengthening real-time monitoring to ensure faster response to any emerging issues.

3.	Optimizing unit operations to significantly reduce lag during large-scale deployments.

Once again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the recent service instability.

Your feedback is valuable to us, and we are committed to incorporating that feedback into future updates to provide a more stable and enjoyable gaming experience.

Thank you for your continued support for Gunship Battle Total Warfare.

[h3][b][Promo Code Notice][/b][/h3]
As a token of our apology for the inconvenience, we have prepared a special promo code.

We hope this small gesture can help ease some of the frustration caused.

[b]Promo Code: THANKYOU2025[/b]

[b]Rewards: [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/b420402a6067792004c4523f1d106fa70321474f.png[/img]
[b]Valid[/b] Until December 31, 2025, 14:59 UTC (December 31, 2025, 07:59 PST)
[b]※ The promo code can be used once per account.[/b]

Thank you.

notes.title: Development Note - Alliance APEX Arena & ASG Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/f77a168644d7ac20e0c57673dc67b8f4922143b2.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals!

This is the Lead Producer of Gunship Battle Total Warfare, Ja-ram Jeon.

We hope the Heroes we introduced in the last update have proven themselves to be a helpful addition to your team.

Today, we’d like to share some news surrounding the new Alliance feature, as well as several improvements that are on the roster for the upcoming update. 


[h3][b]New Feature! Alliance APEX Arena[/b][/h3]

Alliance APEX Arena was built on top of the existing APEX Arena feature currently live in the game. 
This large-scale mode will feature 35 vs 35 Alliance matchups with not just 1, but 2 Fleets used to participate. 

This feature will be available on a weekly basis:
- Application Period: Saturday – Sunday
- Battle Period: Monday (24 hours)

[b]◆ Schedule[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/481056b186986f6deb74611f04052beb4ff433e9.png[/img]
Earn Victory Points through wins to help your Alliance rise through 13 competitive Tiers.

Here’s the Tier designation starting from the lowest to the highest Tier:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/2e8703e77ba6422d92e2d2444267b3c6a44da609.png[/img] 

With the new Alliance APEX Arena feature, we’re introducing cross-World Zone Alliance matchups—a groundbreaking first in Gunship Battle: Total Warfare!


[h3][b]Armada Strike Group Improvements– Automatic Resource Island Removal![/b][/h3]

We've received significant feedback from our community about the resource islands occupying spaces that obstruct their ability to Detect Armada Strike Groups.

To make that problem a thing of the past, we’re implementing changes to ensure that you have space for Detection: 
Any resource islands within the intended Detection area will be automatically removed from the map to free up the required space for ASG Detection. 

However, resource islands that are occupied, or have Ships enroute to the site will not be removed. We’d suggest that any resource gathering and Ship Deployment to the resource sites in the target area be addressed ahead of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/b172829db27b60b8fa07d393a0ce5b2828ea5b45.png[/img]

[h3][b]New! Auto-Extermination & Auto-Rally[/b][/h3]

Engaging the Armada in combat typically requires hands-on control through either the Extermination or Rally functions, which we understand can become demanding at times.
To enhance the overall experience, we are introducing two new features: Auto-Extermination and Auto Rally Participation.
  
The newly added Auto-Extermination and Auto Rally features can remain active for up to 8 hours after activation.
Auto-Extermination consumes Stamina and only works while you are online, whereas Auto Rally remains active both online and offline.

To ensure that our Admirals can make the most of this feature, we’re also developing a system to deploy additional Armada Fleets specifically for Auto-Extermination, as the number of fleets may not be abundant enough during times of high activity.


[h3][b]World Zone Revamp Survey[/b][/h3]
In our February Development Note, we shared our plans for a World Zone revamp.

Since that time, our Admirals have expressed equal parts, enthusiasm and concern.

To gain deeper insight into the needs of our Admirals, we’ve prepared a survey for you to share your thoughts and concerns with us. 

Every response will be carefully reviewed, and constructive suggestions that build upon our game, community and more will be incorporated into future content updates.
 
[b]▶ World Zone Revamp Survey – [url=https://forms.gle/7ECFBWnk9ijjHM8G9][LINK][/url][/b]

Until next time. Thank you!

[b]* Please note that all the details provided here are currently in development and are subject to change. Official updates will be shared via notices.
[/b]

notes.title: March Development Note - Resource Island Buff & Club Shooting Range
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/f77a168644d7ac20e0c57673dc67b8f4922143b2.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals!
This is Ja-ram Jeon, Lead Producer of Gunship Battle: Total Warfare.
How are you enjoying World War League 5.0?
The second round of WWL 5.0 is approaching this week, and we look forward to seeing all Admirals participate in the battle!
Today, we’d like to introduce the newly implemented Resource Island Buff, along with other upcoming improvements.
Let’s take a closer look at the details.

[h3][b][Permanent Resource Island Buff][/b][/h3]
With the Ship Max Level Expansion, we doubled the number of items required for Ship upgrades.
However, this led to a relative shortage of resources.
To address this, we launched a Resource Island Event following the February update maintenance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/df1e755d22cca52ed6685662e1d5256f3bfec73f.png[/img]

Many Admirals have shown interest and are actively gathering resources from these Resource Islands.
In response to this, we’ve decided to make the event permanent so that Admirals can collect even more resources consistently.
We hope you continue to make good use of the buffed Resource Islands to maintain a steady supply of resources.

[h3][b][New Club Shooting Range – Food to Steel][/b][/h3]
Many Admirals have expressed their opinion on adding a feature to exchange Food for Iron.
As Food tends to accumulate more quickly than Iron, we are adding a new Club Shooting Range where Food can be used to obtain Iron.
Unlike the existing Shooting Range, which has no limits, the new Food Shooting Range will have a daily usage limit.
Make sure to visit the Club every day and take advantage of this feature if you need Iron!
We've also received requests to increase the resource exchange limit in the Black Market.
Although this will not be included in the upcoming update, we acknowledge the demand and will review it positively for future implementation.

[h3][b][Rally Chat Improvements][/b][/h3]
Previously, we announced Rally Chat improvements in the January Development Note.
However, due to technical issues found during testing, this feature was postponed.
The updated Rally Chat will now be applied during the March update.
With this improvement:
- Rally Status will no longer be displayed in Alliance Chat.
- A new Rally Icon will appear at the bottom of the screen when a Rally is initiated.
- A new Alliance Rally Tab will be added to the Alliance News menu to display information about Rallies separately.
We hope this change helps prevent Rally Notifications from disrupting Alliance Chat discussions.

[h3][b][Armada Fleet & Royal Armada Fleet Level Expansion][/b][/h3]
Higher level Armada Fleets and Royal Armada Fleets will appear after the March update.
The maximum level will be expanded differently for each World Zone:
- World Zones 1 & 2: Armada Fleets → Up to Level 55, Royal Armada Fleets → Up to Level 60
- World Zone 3: Royal Armada Fleets → Up to Level 50
Higher level Armada Fleets will spawn closer to the Central Sea Area.
We hope this expansion provides an even more exciting challenge for all Admirals.

[h3][b][Alliance Notice Improvements][/b][/h3]
Alliance Notices play a crucial role in Alliance Management.
However, we’ve noticed that Alliance Notices are not always visible enough to all members.
To improve this:
- The "Pin to Chat" feature will be added, allowing Alliance Notices to be pinned in Alliance Chat.
- Links (Coordinates, URLs) will be supported in certain in-game mails.
These improvements will be applied with the March update.

[h3][b][Final Notes][/b][/h3]
Today, we introduced the March update features and improvements.
We will continue working to create a better gameplay experience for all Admirals.
As always, your feedback is invaluable to us. Please continue to share your thoughts so we can refine and enhance Gunship Battle: Total Warfare.
[b]※ Please note that the details and schedule mentioned in this Development Note are subject to change due to internal circumstances.[/b]

notes.title: [World War League 5.0] Pre-Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/438d70a433e0be610e8c352da228ba65e667b621.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals.

As the 5th WWL is approaching, we’re here to bring you information about the event.

WWL 5.0 will feature 5 League Matches, followed by a Final Ranking Match to determine the strongest Server of each League.

Please review the details below.

[h3][b]1. Rules[/b][/h3]

a. WWL 5.0 will have a total of 96 participating Servers.

b. WWL 5.0 will consist of a total of 8 Leagues: World Zone 1 (A-E Leagues), World Zone 2 (F League) and World Zone 3 (G~H League).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/050be74fe4c608a735e6fa6c096a1f67a7120573.png[/img]

c. Each League will be separated by World Zone(s) 1, 2, and 3.
d. Each League consists of 12 Servers.
e. The 12 Servers are divided into 2 sub-groups, each containing 6 Servers.
f . Matches are conducted as 1:1 battles within each sub-group..
g. Winning Servers earn 5 points, while defeated Servers receive 0 points.
h. A total of 5 matches will be held, and rankings within each sub-group will be determined based on total points accumulated.
i. If two Servers have the same total points, rankings will be determined based on head-to-head results.
j. Final Ranking Matches will be held between Servers with the same rank from each sub-group.
k. Final rankings will be determined based on the results of the Final Ranking Match. If a match ends in a draw, the Server with the lower total CP wins. (CP is calculated based on the highest CP achieved by each Admiral.)

[Example]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/f0cf8305201bf67fb510000f2ae999dafbe3d831.png[/img]

The WWL 5.0 Preliminary Matches will be 1:1 battle within the same sub-group.

The winning Server will obtain 5 points and the defeated Server will obtain 0 point.

Example: Server 1 in the BLUE group of league A will be competing against Server 2 ~ Server 6 in the BLUE group (Total of 5 Matches).
If Server 1 wins all battles, it will obtain 25 points. If it loses all battles, it will obtain 0 point.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/84c7310154429a7d56732117b1328f13e3f7eead.png[/img]
 
Rank will be determined within BLUE / RED in the order of points obtained from the WWL 5.0 Preliminary Matches.
If the final score for the WWL 5.0 Group Preliminary Matches is tied, the Server with a later creation date will rank higher.
In the WWL 5.0 Final Ranking Match, tied ranking Servers in the same group will battle.
Example: Server 1 in the BLUE group and Server 12 in the RED group will be competing in the 6th match.

[h3][b]2. Exceptions for Wins and Losses[/b][/h3]

a. Every match will have a winning/losing Server and the following rules will be applied in the case of a draw.

b. If both Servers do not reach the target Occupation Points within the battle period, the match will end in a draw.

c. When comparing Final League Ranking Points, if two Servers tie, the Server with the newer creation date wins.

d. If two Servers have the same creation date, the Server with the lower total CP will win, earning win/loss battle point rewards.

   (CP will be calculated based on the maximum CP achieved by each Admiral.)

e. The final rankings will be determined based on the outcomes of the Final Ranking Matches, the Server with the newer creation date will be given a higher ranking in case of a tie.

f. If two Servers have the same creation date, the Server with the lower total CP will win.

   (CP will be calculated based on the maximum CP achieved by each Admiral.)

g. If both Servers have reached 50,000 or more points during the battle period, the following rules will be applied.

h. The Server with the most Final Occupation Points will win.

i. If the Final Occupation Points are the same, the Server with the later creation date will win. 

j. If the Final Occupation Points / creation date are both the same, the Server with a lower total Combat Power will win.

(CP will be calculated based on the maximum CP achieved by each Admiral.)

[h3][b]3. League Rewards[/b][/h3]
a. Match Victory / Defeat Rewards
ㄴ Match rewards will be distributed to Servers based on the result of each Match. Rewards vary depending on the League.
ㄴ Match rewards will only be given to Admirals who participated in battles by moving their Aircraft Carrier into the battlefield.

b. Final League Ranking Rewards
ㄴ Final rewards will be distributed based on Server rankings after the Final Ranking Match.
ㄴ The reward tier will vary depending on the League.
ㄴ Admirals must participate in at least 4 out of 6 matches to qualify for Final Ranking Rewards.

c. Top 20 Contribution Rewards
ㄴ For each match, the top 10 Admirals who contributed the most in Attack and Defense will receive special rewards.
ㄴ Admirals can only receive one type of Contribution Reward per match.
If an Admiral qualifies for both Attack and Defense Top 10 Rewards, they will receive the Attack Top 10 Reward.
ㄴ The Defense Top 10 Reward will be given to the next eligible Admiral.
ㄴ Contribution rewards will only be given to Admirals who actively participated by deploying their Aircraft Carrier in the battlefield.
More details regarding rewards will be announced later.

[h3][b]4. Schedule for WWL 5.0[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/2b6d03727d842d4c46a8a1412bb6a3c6e6543fdf.png[/img]

[h3][b]5. WWL 5.0 Repair Speed Buff Distribution[/b][/h3]

In order to reduce the burden of repair costs, [Repair Speed + 200%] buff will be distributed to all Admirals participating in WWL 5.0. 

The Buff will be sent to the participating Admirals 1 hour before the start of each Match via in-game mail, and it will last for 25 hours.
[b]※ The mail will expire after 24 hours, so please claim it before the match starts.[/b]
The Servers & Groups in WWL 5.0 will be announced at a later date.
Please stay tuned for World War League 5.0, and hope everyone can strive for victory!

Thank you

notes.title: Introducing the New Legendary Jet [EF VORTEX 2020]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/438d70a433e0be610e8c352da228ba65e667b621.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals.

We are here to introduce the EF VORTEX 2020, a special operations Jet specialized in Anti-Air attacks and equipped with a new skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/44c43fae86aebb5f514fe69a55c4fa36e17a412b.png[/img]
 
It has been a while since we introduced EF 2000 with a new paint pattern and decals.
 
As a multi-role Jet, it boasts excellent compatibility with various armaments, making it a valuable asset in various operations.
One of its key features is the small forward wings, 'Canards,' which enhances its maneuverability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/fb98fecfcab1dff33fc08fd27c2eba14c9943bf2.png[/img]

The newly released EF VORTEX 2020 takes its name from the concept of paralyzing enemies.
 
As the name suggests, it is designed to unleash its full potential with its unique Skill III - [Specialized in Air Strikes that have a chance to block Ship deployment].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/96e60ca1dc5722b5d52cdda4abb9d5b1a6c06d20.png[/img]

This skill activates with a certain probability when attacking enemy Aircraft Carriers, rendering all Ships in the Carrier Strike Group and Base temporarily unusable.
* Ship operations include: Attack / Support / Stationing

With its exceptional maneuverability, EF VORTEX 2020 will pressure enemy warships and be a formidable asset in various battlefields, Admiral!

[h4][b]Stats[/b][/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/b033939b36ff9801f87af425674f028f6ea942df.png[/img]
[b]* Stats of EF VORTEX 2020 at Lv.30 with no Buffs activated.[/b]

[h4][b]Skills[/b][/h4]

● Skill I [Critical Chance and Malfunction Effect Enhancement] (Unlocks at Jet Level 5)
      - Increases Critical Chance and Malfunction Effect Enhancement by 3% ~ 60% (Percentage varies depending on the Skill Level)

● Skill II [Specialized in Anti-Air ATK] (Unlocks at Jet Level 10)
       - Increases Anti-Air ATK by 10% ~ 200% (Percentage varies depending on the Skill Level)

● Skill III [Specialized in Air Strikes that have a chance to block Ship deployment] (Unlocks at Jet Level 15)
       - Upon a successful Airstrike, there is a 1.75% ~ 35% chance to disable the deployment of Carrier Strike Group warships for 5 seconds.
       * The highest rate from amongst the squadron is applied in full. 
        (Other squadrons’ rates are divided by 2/3/4 (in order from highest to lowest) before application)

● Skill IV [ATK Enhancement] (Unlocks at Jet Level 20)
        - Increases ATK by 10% ~ 105% (Percentage varies depending on the Skill Level)

[h4][b]How to Obtain[/b][/h4]

- Ranking Event
- Shop
- Special Deals
- Armada Strike Group


Thank you.

notes.title: Development Note – about WWL 5.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/f77a168644d7ac20e0c57673dc67b8f4922143b2.png[/img]
Greetings, Admirals!
This is Ja-ram Jeon, Lead Producer of Gunship Battle: Total Warfare.

I’m here to announce an exciting new challenge and goal for our Admirals.
As previously mentioned, the pinnacle of Gunship Battle: Total Warfare,
World War League, is returning with an all-new season! 

Let’s take a closer look at the details.

[h4][b][WWL 5.0][/b][/h4]
The World War League 5.0 is quickly approaching!

WWL 5.0 will follow the same structure as all previous World War Leagues —Admirals will battle within their assigned leagues to accumulate points, which will then be used to determine the final ranking match. 

Details regarding rules, league assignments, and rewards will be shared in upcoming announcements.
Please stay tuned for further updates!

For today, as promised in our December Developer’s Note, we want to provide a clear and transparent explanation of how Servers will be divided into their respective groups.

Servers will be assigned to a league based on the Server Combat Power, which is calculated by summing up the Combat Power of the top 50 Admirals of each Server.
Each league will be made up of Servers of similar Combat Power.


Below is the current ranking and Combat Power status for each Server.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/480901a6f3394fee7fc90426901e12394ad32378.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/ca48f88387ae762b591a1961f95b0e458c6fa0e5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/ee8d0df5efafdf4be7ab5488b9ff8a2b3f0472a8.png[/img]

For example, 12 Servers from World Zone 1 with the highest Combat Powers will be assigned to League A.
Servers are separated into the RED or BLUE team.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45361687/6d304b06ac5ad8e84d3e890b0597ddd93cde3d44.png[/img]

WWL 5.0 League Composition
WWL 5.0 will consist of a total of 96 Servers that will be divided into Leagues A to H.

League assignments will be finalized once Server Transfer Event is over. Details of the Server matching will be shared in an official announcement along with each of the participating Servers and the corresponding Combat Power.

Removal of Reinforcement System 
Starting with WWL 5.0, the Reinforcement System will be removed to ensure a smoother and more optimized battle environment for all Admirals.

Today, we shared how the leagues for WWL 5.0 be structured.
As mentioned above, once Server Transfer ends and the matchmaking is finalized, we will share the details in a future notice.

Additionally, following the conclusion of WWL 5.0, we are planning an update to restructure World Zones.
We know many Admirals have been eagerly awaiting this, so please share your suggestions in an upcoming survey. All feedback is greatly appreciated and will be taken into consideration when preparing the changes. 

Thank you for your continued support and passion for Gunship Battle: Total Warfare.
We are committed to delivering exciting and enjoyable content for all Admirals.

[b]※ Please note that the details and schedule mentioned in this Developer’s Note are subject to change due to internal circumstances.[/b]

Thank you!

notes.title: Celebrating Official Steam Release! New Jet Blueprint Reward
notes.content:
Greetings, Admirals.

To celebrate the official release of Gunship Battle: Total Warfare on Steam, we’re excited to announce the release of new Jet, the Red Dragon, and we've prepared special events for you, Admiral.

For more details, please refer to the information below.

[b]● Schedule[/b]
- From January 15, 2025, 11:00, UTC (January 15, 2025, 03:00, PST)
- Until March 12, 2025, UTC (March 11, 2025, PST) before maintenance

[b]● Rewards[/b]
1) 35 Red Dragon Blueprints (For 7 days starting from the first login via Steam)
2) 20 Red Dragon Blueprints for every 100 Stamina used (Up to 10 times)

[b]● Notes[/b]
- This event is available only in-game.
- For reward 1), daily rewards will be available for 7 days starting from the first login via Steam.
- For reward 2), rewards can be obtained from the event popup within the game.
